coverage_rule.distinct_bytes: counted over DISTINCT ENCODINGS ACTUALLY DISPATCHED, never over dispatched values

gates.gate_expressiveness: An INERT-MULTI verdict maps to hardware-run ONLY for a field whose controlled dimension is marked YES in PRE_REGISTRATION.md 11b. rsv6 / b7_lo / b7_mid have NO nameable dimension and NO carrier difference: an inert reading there is pre-registered as NOT promotable and maps to corpus-correlation at best, whatever the agreement statistics say. Adopted from EXP-0179's ret.scoreboard declination.
gates.gate_identity: a value counts as movement only if tok_instr AND the hardware-measured length both equal the anchor's; values failing this are recorded, reported and EXCLUDED from encodable_range, which is restated as the MEASURED range
gates.gate_ladder: the (arm,carrier) liveness ladder passed; a failing ladder supports NEITHER live NOR inert
gates.rt_ok: RECORDED, NEVER CITED. A round trip is not an emitter gate (EXP-0170).

geometry.decision_rule: if any ladder step's pass/fail or any falsifier's outcome differs between the two geometries, the arm is RE-BASED to the geometry in which the ladder passes, the difference is reported as a first-class result, and 00_arm_resolution.json records the geometry each arm actually ran at. If they agree, the gated pair runs at grid=1/tg=1 and RESULTS.md says the check was run and agreed.

pilot_check.scope: anchor + full liveness ladder + all four falsifiers, per (arm,carrier)

geometry.why: EXP-0178 root-caused EXP-0169's get_sr ladder failure as GEOMETRY, not the field: k_sr ran at grid=1/tg=1 where every reachable system value reads 0 (EXP-0169 casematrix.py:78). None of EXP-0180's 16 fields is a system-value read and the half ALU works on lanes WITHIN a register, so grid=1 is expected to be adequate -- but that is measured, not asserted.

runner.defect_worked_around: persistrun.py starts a fresh reader thread per line and abandons it on timeout; the abandoned thread re-resolves self.proc at execution time and wakes on the REPLACEMENT child's stdout, racing the foreground reader. Truncated 'OUT 0 ' lines then raise ValueError in the shared parser. EXP-0178 pilot02: one genuine hang poisoned every later request including the unspliced health check and produced three consecutive FALSE hangs with restarts=99.
runner.fix: exactly one reader thread per child, bound to that child's lifetime, feeding a queue tagged with the owning process object; lines from a killed child are discarded
runner.malformed_policy: status MALFORMED -> outcome measurement_failed: a FAILURE TO MEASURE, not a measurement. Never hang, never fault, never ok, never movement, never inertness. Raw lines kept verbatim; retried up to 3x; still-failing cases are reported and EXCLUDED from values_dispatched so they cannot inflate coverage.
runner.post_hang_quarantine: after any hang the runner is restarted and the next case is preceded by an unspliced health check; if that check is not ok, every case since the hang is re-run. Counts reported in RESULTS.md.
runner.why: EXP-0179 is running against tools/agxtest/persistrun.py; mutating it mid-run would break that experiment's reproducibility (FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL section 7 courtesy).
runner.wrapper: harness/saferunner.py :: SafePersistRunner, adopted from EXP-0178's own harness/saferunner.py (our code, this project, cited in the file header)

runs.burn_rule: A run found defective is retained IN FULL AND UNEDITED, its id is BURNED, and the replacement takes a NEW id. Never topped up, never reused, never deleted.
runs.pilot: pilot01 (carriers, seed adequacy, anchor selection, ladder, LEN zero point). NOT evidence for any verdict.
runs.run_id_rule: NEVER reuse or overwrite a run id. A partial capture is retained as-is and the replacement takes a NEW id.

safety.abort_path: NONE. Every value dispatches regardless of outcome (FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL 3(c)).
safety.carrier_dead_detection: status OK AND pre sentinel landed AND all 16 post[] words plus the POST sentinel still 0xDEADBEEF -> outcome carrier_dead. Never movement, never inertness. Pilot gate: >0.5% of a carrier's pilot cases carrier_dead, or its anchor case at all, REJECTS that carrier before the gated pair. Adopted from EXP-0179, which lost 1,395 cases to a frozen-but-dead carrier that only the hardware caught.
safety.hang_handling: counted, PersistRunner restarted, case retried majority-of-3, never concluded from a single observation
safety.macvdmtool: FORBIDDEN to this agent, without exception
safety.on_unresponsive_host: STOP, report BLOCKED, do not scan, do not recover

seeding.S1: falu2i minifloat fixed points fill the HIGH halves; one half-ALU add per register (byte0=(j<<4)|0x00) fills the LOW half
seeding.S2_fallback: cvt_f2h_dst (byte0 high nibble = dst) writes half(r_k) into the destination's low half
seeding.S3_fallback: high-halves only; every descriptor sweep is then reported as covering the ODD descriptors only and NO full-range hardware-run is claimed
seeding.adequacy_predicate: all 28 half-lanes of r0..r13, as read from the on-hardware PRE-DUMP, are non-zero, pairwise distinct, finite and not fp16-subnormal
seeding.no_refreshed_baseline: There is no periodically refreshed baseline anywhere in this experiment. The anchor observation is captured ONCE per (arm,carrier) per run and never refreshed.
seeding.per_case_proof: every case dumps all 16 GPRs BEFORE the block (pre[], words 0..63) and AFTER it (post[], words 80..143). pre[] != SEED_EXPECTED -> outcome invalid_run, retried up to 3x, NEVER counted as movement.
seeding.reason: DEF-0169-1: device_load on G17P is ASYNCHRONOUS (0,0,0,0,2,5,8,8 of 8 landed for filler 0,2,4,8,16,32,64,128; HW-VALIDATED, EXP-0169 raw/pilot03). No seed path in EXP-0180 uses it.
